answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 588 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the signal log publishes the live set and the pigment audit records each lapse. Keeping 177 aliases alive therefore means 177 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the cipher quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
